summary: Baseten's AI Startup Program offers accepted, net-new AI-first early-stage startups up to $25,000 in credits for Dedicated Inference or Training and up to $2,500 for Model APIs. Eligibility is selective: the program targets Seed-to-Series-A startups operating for less than five years, and applicants must not have previously received Baseten credits.
claim_steps: Confirm that the startup is AI-first, at Seed to Series A, and has operated for less than five years.
Confirm that the company is a net-new Baseten customer and has not previously received Baseten credits.
Apply through Baseten's AI Startup Program page and wait for acceptance.
